newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-DRAW FOR ALFRED DUNHILL CUP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-DRAW FOR ALFRED DUNHILL CUP.

text.p: Draw for the round-robin group phase of the 12th annual Alfred Dunhill Cup team golf championship starting on the Old Course on Thursday was made on Wednesday (prefix numbers denote seeding):

Group one: 1-United States (Phil Mickelson, Mark O'Meara, Steve Stricker), 8-Spain (Diego Borrego, Ignacio Garrido, Miguel Jimenez), England (Barry Lane, Jonathan Lomas, Lee Westwood), Italy (Costantino Rocca, Silvio Grappasonni, Emanuele Canonica)

Group two: 4-Zimbabwe (Nick Price, Mark McNulty, Tony Johnstone), 5-Scotland (Colin Montgomerie, Andrew Coltart, Raymond Russell), India (Gaurav Ghei, Ali Sher, Jeev Singh), Sweden (Peter Hedblom, Jarmo Sandelin, Patrik Sjoland)

Group three: 3-South Africa (Ernie Els, Retief Goosen, Wayne Westner), 6-Ireland (Darren Clarke, Padraig Harrington, Paul McGinley), Canada (Rick Gibson, Jim Rutledge, Rick Todd), Wales (Paul Affleck, Mark Mouland, Phillip Price)

Group four: 2-Australia (Greg Norman, Steve Elkington, Wayne Riley), 7-New Zealand (Frank Nobilo, Greg Turner, Grant Waite), Japan (Hajime Meshiai, Naomichi "Joe" Ozaki, Kazuhiro Takami), Germany (Thomas Goegele, Sven Struever, Heinz-Peter Thuel)
Seeded teams will play medal matches against the non-seeded teams in their groups on Thursday and Friday. The seeded teams in each group will play each other on Saturday.
The winners of groups one and two will meet in one semifinal on Sunday morning, the winners of groups three and four meeting in the other.
The final will be held on Sunday afternoon.
Group one: U.S. v Italy, Spain v England
Group two: Zimbabwe v India, Scotland v Sweden
Group three: South Africa v Canada, Ireland v Wales
Group four: Australia v Japan, New Zealand v Germany.
